title: PicoMado Bluetooth A2DP audio and AVRCP remote input

introduction_cause: PicoMado has no Bluetooth audio adapter or audio transport.
escape_cause: Not a regression; new functionality. Standalone A2DP tone evidence does not prove AVRCP or Wi-Fi coexistence.

Capability-negotiated device audio and setup UI
